tag_line: You can see your own vehicle!
title: Realistic Vehicle Mirrors
message:
This mod adds picture-in-picture UI mirrors. This allows you to see your [B]own[/B] vehicle in the image compared to the dynamic reflection ones.

[ATTACH]980610[/ATTACH]

[B][SIZE=5][U]VERY IMPORTANT![/U][/SIZE]
Please turn OFF the following graphics settings to avoid graphical glitches:[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Anti-Aliasing (don't use FXAA)[/B]
[*][B]Bloom[/B]
[*][B]Ambient Occlusion[/B]
[*][B]Motion Blur[/B]
[*][B]Shadows (only if shadow flickering occurs)[/B]
[/LIST]
[B]Also vehicle lights don't work when mirrors are active :(
And for performance, use the Vulkan renderer!

As of the 1.1x update, "Use Efficient Rendering" is disabled as shadows flicker most often with all mirrors rendering. You can either disable shadows to use "Use Efficient Rendering" mode or leave "Use Efficient Rendering" turned off with shadows on.[/B]

To use the mod, spawn in a vanilla vehicle with wing mirrors (modded vehicles may not work) and simply press [B]F3[/B] (default keybinding) to toggle between the different mirror modes (Off, Side Mirrors Only, Rear View Mirror Only, All Mirrors). You can drag the mirrors around the screen with the [B]left mouse button[/B] and also resize them. [B]Right-clicking[/B] an individual mirror opens per-mirror controls so you can adjust the mirror camera [B]position (horizontal/vertical)[/B], its [B]viewing angle (yaw/pitch)[/B], and global rendering settings.

[ATTACH]986512[/ATTACH] 

If right-clicking a mirror doesn't work, press ~ (tilde) key first and try again.
